decision_cruda.rationale: LH-05 down at N522-13 (radio+CMMS agree, likely repair 11:30). The idle LH-10 at the workshop costs nothing to move, and it gets there in 0.69h (10:41). It loads about 8t before lunch, and the stope has 210t that LH-05 alone can't finish after 11:30. Norte stockpile has room (247/450), so the added inflow is not truck-limited in practice. No development loader is taken. Gain is small, about 3 oz.
